# 觀音經義疏記會本科

**ID:** X0643
**Volume:** X35

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juan* anonymous *kēwén* 科文 (sectional analysis) of the late-Míng combined edition of [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE)'s Zhīlǐ *Guānyīn yìshū jì* ([KR6d0049](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0049), T1729). Together with its parallel *tiáogè* outline ([KR6d0054](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0054)) and the corresponding apparatus on the *Xuányì jì* ([KR6d0050](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0050), [KR6d0051](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0051)), it constitutes the late-Míng auxiliary navigational apparatus on Zhīlǐ's *Pǔmén* corpus undertaken by [王季常](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%8B%E5%AD%A3%E5%B8%B8) Wáng Jìcháng's circle in 1628–1629.

**Abstract**

The *Kēwén* parallels [KR6d0050](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0050) (the *Xuányì jì kēwén*) in providing a structural-outline navigational aid to the corresponding combined-edition text. The two *kēwén* together reflect the standardised late-Míng editorial method for major Sòng commentarial works: pair each principal subcommentary with both a sectional-analysis (*kēwén*) and a topic-outline (*tiáogè*) navigational aid, providing readers with both hierarchical structural and topic-index entry points into the dense scholastic text.

The dating is most plausibly fixed to the period of the parallel combined-edition project (1628–1629), with the bracket extended to 1700 to allow for late-Míng or early-Qing redactional activity. The work was incorporated into the Manji-zoku canonical apparatus from the Jīnlíng / Jiāxīngzàng publishing tradition.
